blurb: Portfolio blurbs are usually generated by hand, not by an automated pipeline validating its own output. Built blurbot to do exactly that: a tool that drafts and critiques "recent work" blurbs from GitHub activity, checking its own drafts against a style guide before producing clean, ready-to-use output. Used it to update the recent-work blurb on the portfolio site, which also picked up a new "Currently Building" section around the same time.
